identity.title: Audit public file input size and boundary policy

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and current-source/package audit
origin.summary: 2D-023 asks for one consistent root and size boundary across JSON, XML, and artifact inputs. Current source and the exact DEV integration packages were inspected before deciding whether a safe implementation boundary exists.

state.current_summary: The existing root and reparse owners are intact and the upstream TCP/review-bundle limits are known, but general Pipeline XML, locator JSON, local integration messages, and generic artifacts have no product-approved common maximum or typed oversized error contract. Runtime behavior must not gain an arbitrary compatibility-breaking limit.
state.next_action: After product approval of per-entry and aggregate ceilings, TCP inheritance/lowering, and typed error mapping, add the smallest owner-level pre-read checks and a focused long-path/Korean/oversized/traversal/reparse contract. Until then, proceed with independent 2D-024 work.
state.blocker: A supported maximum for local Pipeline XML, locator JSON, integration envelopes, and artifacts is not defined; existing limits are heterogeneous (review bundle 5/2 MiB, TCP 4/16 GiB plus frame/path bounds).
state.unblock_condition: Product decision records each local per-entry/aggregate byte ceiling, whether local exchange inherits or lowers TCP defaults, and the stable typed error code/message for oversized input.

objective.summary: Audit the current public file input owners, prove existing root/reparse behavior and upstream size bounds, and preserve an explicit blocker instead of inventing a new input policy.
constraints: Reuse AppPathService, RecipeWorkspaceService, TwoDIntegrationExchange, VisionPipelineXmlSchemaPolicy, review-bundle inspector, and shared TCP package owners; do not add a duplicate path/security framework.
Do not modify user files, C:\Git\2D\Original, hardware, or external services; keep test evidence on D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not reopen or reimplement resolved PL-0007 path behavior or rerun a duplicate process/UI campaign.
Do not commit, push, release, deploy, or perform external communication.

criteria.text: Current root, relative-path, and reparse owners and their call paths are identified without a competing owner.
Existing review-bundle and shared TCP size/path bounds are verified from the exact DEV package/source state.
The absence of a common local JSON/XML/message/artifact maximum is recorded as a product blocker; no arbitrary runtime limit is introduced.
Focused current-source build and existing root regression contracts pass, while normal integration evidence and remaining long-path/UI boundaries are stated honestly.

context.location: AppPathService and RecipeWorkspaceService own application/Recipe storage containment; TwoDIntegrationExchange owns local transaction path/reparse and message/artifact reads; VisionPipelineXmlSchemaPolicy/SerializeHelper own Pipeline XML schema gate; TwoDIntegrationLocatorRecipeContract owns locator JSON reads; review-bundle inspector and shared TCP package own their separate bounded inputs.
Public file -> existing owner -> full-path/reparse or schema/contract validation -> decode/deserialize/compute. The unbounded local paths read bytes/text before any size decision.

Root/traversal/reparse failure remains fail-closed. Size behavior is intentionally not claimed stable for general local XML/JSON/message/artifact inputs until the product chooses ceilings and typed errors.

OPENVISIONLAB_2D_PUBLIC_FILE_INPUT_BOUNDARY_AUDIT_20260915.md -> AppPathService.cs -> RecipeWorkspaceService.cs -> SerializeHelper.cs/VisionPipelineXmlSchemaPolicy.cs -> TwoDIntegrationExchange.cs/TwoDIntegrationLocatorRecipeContract.cs -> review-bundle inspector -> shared TCP models/protocol/docs -> focused contracts.
No actual multi-gigabyte user file, explicit Windows long-path integration combination, WPF UI/DPI, hardware, clean release distribution, or Original repository mutation was performed.

artifacts.summary: Source/package matrix, owner call paths, acceptance comparison, and exact product unblock decision.
Source/upstream audit, package hash/probe, Debug/Release builds, and AppPath/PL-0007 regression outputs.

evidence.observation: Current source confirms transaction-relative full-path and reparse checks, while local ReadMessage, locator JSON reads, and Pipeline XML file loads use File.ReadAllBytes/File.ReadAllText without a common maximum. The review-bundle owner is the separate bounded input path.

The existing AppPath contract passed 8/8 and the existing PL-0007 Recipe storage path contract passed on current Debug and Release smoke binaries; these owners cover root/traversal/name boundary behavior without introducing a duplicate path owner.

Exact shared commit f4743f3307d20a963b2197f2019713320b9859b and alpha.3 hashes were checked. TCP defaults are 1,024 files, 4 GiB per file, 16 GiB per transaction, 1 MiB control frame, and 1 KiB UTF-8 relative path; review-bundle limits are 5 MiB pipeline and 2 MiB manifest.

Reflection probe of the exact Contracts alpha.3 validator accepted generic artifact ByteLength values 4 GiB, 16 GiB, and Int64.MaxValue without a max-size issue; this is a validator-policy probe, not a claim that a multi-gigabyte file was created.

VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug and Release builds completed with zero errors (existing nullable warnings remain). AppPath boundary passed 8/8 in both configurations; PL-0007 Recipe storage path regression passed in both configurations.
Existing OVL-02 evidence covers normal 2D Handoff→Acknowledgement→Run→Result and TCP receive-without-auto-ack/run. This cycle did not duplicate that completed normal integration campaign.

The boundary is recorded as blocked rather than changed: no arbitrary local size limit or security framework was introduced, and the handoff advances the sole automation to independent 2D-024 work while naming the exact product unblock decision.

events.summary: Keep 2D-023 blocked because the requested common local size policy and typed oversized error mapping are product compatibility decisions, not safe autonomous defaults. Preserve existing path/reparse owners and move the scheduler to independent 2D-024 work.
2D-023 source/package audit and focused regressions completed; implementation is blocked by the missing product-approved input size contract.
